column2:
Equity is at the heart of the SDGs, which are found on
the concept of “leaving no one behind”
Address health and well-being at all ages, including
newborns and children, adolescents, adult women and
men, and older persons
Not only is the goal to be monitored much broader, but
it is also extended over time, and will thus require a
comprehensive, life-course approach
Needless to say, such an approach will also be relevant in
monitoring progress towards UHC
